subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman sighted on the rooftop in <Picture 3>: mid-length brown wavy hair with a blunt fringe, a beige tailored suit over a white top, a black pair of binoculars and a red shoulder-bag strap.
<Subject 2> is the woman in the face close-up of <Picture 4>: dark short hair with a blunt fringe, red geometric-frame glasses, a silver hoop earring and a red high collar, with the reflected Minimax facade held in her right lens.
<Subject 3> is the hanging fabric banner in <Picture 2>: a long white cloth carrying vertical black MINIMAX lettering and fixed to the apartment facade, its lower end curled over to show a red reverse side.
<Subject 4> is the fixed dual-circular binocular mask shared by <Picture 1>–<Picture 4>: a black feathered vignette around a heart-shaped twin-circle opening whose position, size and edge softness stay absolutely identical for the whole video, so that only the imagery inside the opening moves.
<Subject 5> is the red caption layer visible in <Picture 1>–<Picture 4>: the paired left-hand sighting line and right-hand field-note line printed inside the mask, with the wording supplied per picture in the description below.
<Picture 1> is the keyframe anchor for [Shot 1]: the warm low-sun bus shelter with MINIMAX lettering on its canopy, a MINIMAX shadow across the concrete wall, a green "5 AV" sign at the left and a symmetric street framing.
<Picture 2> is the keyframe anchor for [Shot 2]: the upward view of the pale apartment facade with <Subject 3> hanging across its window grid.
<Picture 3> is the keyframe anchor for [Shot 3]: the rooftop with <Subject 1> at the left of frame, a concrete parapet and the facade carrying vertical MINIMAX lettering at the right.
<Picture 4> is the keyframe anchor for [Shot 4]: the close-up of <Subject 2> against the soft pale facade and its red vertical element.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video uses <Picture 1>–<Picture 4> as four consecutive keyframe sightings viewed through <Subject 4>, so the city changes inside a mask that never moves. It opens on a defocused handheld view that a fast push-in racks onto <Picture 1>, then binocular whip-scans carry the sighting from <Subject 3>'s banner to <Subject 1> on the rooftop and finally to <Subject 2> in close-up, with <Subject 5> loading at every landing. The look is Wes Anderson voyeuristic 35mm film — fine grain, soft highlight bloom, restrained warm color and red text accents — minimal and elevated with a slightly quirky liveliness, ending on a cool, relaxed fashion-campaign hold.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved — keeps the identity anchors above through one continuous walk, turn and arm swing.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 4]): fully_preserved — keeps the identity anchors above, including the reflected facade held in the right lens.
<Subject 3> ([Shot 2]): fully_preserved — hanging position, proportions and lettering retained; only the cloth surface moves.
<Subject 4> (all shots): fully_preserved — identical mask position, size and edge softness; no deformation, drift or edge change at any point.
<Subject 5> (all shots): partially_preserved — wording retained per picture, but each pair exists only for its shot's focus load and clears before the next scan.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] keyframe): fully_preserved — core composition, framing, camera angle and the MINIMAX shelter placement.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] keyframe): fully_preserved — core composition, framing, camera angle and the banner's placement on the facade.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] keyframe): fully_preserved — core composition, framing, camera angle and the rooftop layout.
<Picture 4> ([Shot 4] keyframe): fully_preserved — core composition, framing, camera angle and the close-up placement.

detailed_description:
The target video is a Wes Anderson voyeuristic 35mm film look — fine grain, soft highlight bloom, restrained warm color and red text accent — minimal and elevated with a slightly quirky liveliness, and no new people, vehicles, buildings or logos appear anywhere. <Subject 4> stays locked over every frame with identical position, size and edge softness, so the handheld shake, the push-in, the whips and every refocus happen only to the imagery inside the opening. Every cut is a binocular scan: the interior image whips in the stated direction, accelerating into heavy motion blur and optical ghosting with a brief exposure flicker at the peak, and the switch happens inside that blur peak; the same unfinished sweep then continues in the same direction inside the incoming shot, decelerating, stabilizing and refocusing onto the new sighting.
[Shot 1] The interior image begins badly defocused under a handheld shake, so only soft light and color read inside the mask while low street ambience plays underneath. A fast push-in starts and a rack focus resolves the shaking view onto <Picture 1>: the symmetric bus shelter in low warm sun, MINIMAX lettering on the canopy, the MINIMAX shadow across the concrete wall and the green "5 AV" sign at the left. As the focus settles, the left red caption "MINIMAX CITY SIGHTING PUBLIC SPACE" and the right red caption "FIELD NOTE [ SHADOW ] LOOK CLOSER" load slightly defocused and low in opacity and resolve to clear within 0.3–0.5 seconds, drifting a few pixels upward as they sharpen, with no rotation, bounce or wide fly-in. Near the end of the shot they dim and are carried off by the blur as the view whips up and to the right, a short air swish entering with it until the interior image is no longer readable.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, that same right-and-up sweep continues inside the mask, decelerating out of peak blur, settling and refocusing onto <Picture 2>, the upward view of the pale apartment facade. The framing then holds essentially still while <Subject 3> moves: the cloth lifts and settles along its length in a restrained wind, its rustle riding the visible flutter, and the vertical MINIMAX lettering rides the undulating surface while staying legible. The left red caption "MINIMAX CITY SIGHTING FABRIC SIGNAL" and the right red caption "FIELD NOTE [ ABOVE ] LOOK CLOSER" load with the focus in the same soft-to-clear way, then dim and are swept off by the blur as the view whips down and to the left.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.700, that same down-and-left sweep continues inside the mask, slowing out of the blur and refocusing onto <Picture 3>: the rooftop with <Subject 1> at the left of frame, the concrete parapet and the facade carrying vertical MINIMAX lettering at the right. The framing holds steady as she walks, turns and swings her arms through one unhurried, unposed movement, the black binoculars and the red bag strap travelling with her, so she reads as a fashion passerby caught by chance rather than a posed model. The captions "MINIMAX CITY SIGHTING ROOFTOP VIEW" and "FIELD NOTE [ OBSERVER ] LOOK CLOSER" load as the focus lands and clear as the view whips to the right and closes toward the face.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, that same rightward sweep continues inside the mask, decelerating and refocusing onto <Picture 4>: the close-up of <Subject 2> against the soft pale facade. She lightly adjusts the red glasses at the bridge and settles with her chin slightly lifted, one small unhurried gesture that leaves a cool, relaxed fashion-campaign attitude, while the reflected facade stays in her right lens. The captions "MINIMAX CITY SIGHTING REFLECTION" and "FIELD NOTE [ GLASS ] LOOK CLOSER" load with the focus, and the shot settles into a final static hold that keeps them legible through the end of the video.

overall_soundscape:
Low city ambience runs under the whole video, with distant traffic and open street air around the first sighting, wind that lifts and drops the banner cloth around the second, and thinner rooftop air with far-off traffic around the third. The masked optics give a small mechanical tick as each focus lands, and every scan carries a short air swish that peaks at the blur and dies away as the view settles. The final close-up drops to quiet, close air.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained chamber-pop cue at a light walking tempo, led by plucked pizzicato strings, a soft vibraphone and light woodblock accents, marking each focus landing and thinning to a single sustained vibraphone note over the final close-up.
